note: meologue offers no menu widget at all — no aria-haspopup, no role=menu. The row carries its controls inline and always mounted.

meologueJobsOffered: plus recolour, which Todoist reaches through Edit
comparisonToTodoist.absenceJustified: label-types.ts carries no favourite and no shared flag, and no /todo/labels/:labelId route exists for a link to point at. These three have nothing to be built against.
comparisonToTodoist.verdict: DIVERGENT BY SHAPE, and the shape was chosen deliberately — the two jobs that apply are present, the three that do not apply are absent, and meologue's inline controls are reachable by keyboard without a hover, which Todoist's hover-revealed menu trigger is not.
